## Methods

Tumour volume (mm^3) was analysed with a mixed ANOVA with the group as a between-subjects factor and time as a within-subjects factor (n = 23 subjects, 7 time points). 1 subject(s) without a value at every time point were excluded. Sphericity was assessed with Mauchly's test (W = 0.000, P = 2.1e-37); because it was rejected, the within-subject effects carry the Greenhouse-Geisser correction (epsilon = 0.195). arm, F(2, 20) = 28.43, P < 0.001, partial eta squared = 0.740; day, F(1.17, 23.42) = 236.20, P < 0.001, partial eta squared = 0.922; arm:day, F(2.34, 23.42) = 28.83, P < 0.001, partial eta squared = 0.742. The figure shows the mean +/- SEM at each time point, with one thin line per subject. Computed in Python 3.10.12 with numpy 1.26.4 and scipy 1.15.3, and drawn with matplotlib 3.10.9.
